description: Application for a Non-Material Amendment in (S96a) seeking to allow amend the wording of condition 33 in relation to planning permission reference 251293VAR dated 23/02/2026 for: Minor material amendment (S.73) to vary condition no.2 (approved plans), seeking to allow changes on the ground floor, unit numbers and co-living amenity space and design changes, in pursuant to planning permission reference 235015FUL dated 28/03/2025 for: Construction of a building stepped from 4 to 9 storeys comprising co-living units (Sui Generis) and associated communal amenity facilities and ground floor commercial space (Use Classes E(a), E(b) and F2(b); and associated refuse storage and cycle parking (following demolition of the existing buildings and structures)
